steps: Verify boot/UI/touch/buttons and initial scan before requesting human actions
One WPA2 join: IP/router/Safari; freeze logs
One switch to other network, no retry: verify accepted ticket, old retirement, fresh scan, new handshake/IP and human result
One OFF then ON: capture throughout and inspect independent fatal bundle before more actions
If all stages work, optional 5GHz/OPEN follow-up within remaining management PID budget
restrictions: Only exact newly authorized boot image may be flashed
No stock Android boot over iOS userdata
One USB log collector at a time
Do not assert DHCP from link/counter alone
Do not continue toggles on failed native owner
Restore verified618 or tested RAMADB only under conditional recovery authorization
known_limits: ~10 successful connections per boot, fewer with management retries
Power crash not reproduced by exact synthetic sequencing; diagnostics required
Full fresh scan can add ~7s before replacement attempt
